title: Codex v2 Live Run Receipt (issue #464)
description: Durable ledger receipt for the one live Codex v2 run admitted by issue #464. Issue #464 requires the run's failure states to remain expressible after the fact; the hand-authored receipt was previously unschematized, so every state below PASS could only be described in prose. This schema makes verdict, failure_state and per-lane state machine-checkable, and couples them so a PASS cannot carry a failure and a FAIL cannot claim none.

subject.description: The queue subject the run was authorized against, and the commit this receipt lands on. A receipt whose queue subject is not an ancestor of its landing commit is the STALE_SUBJECT failure state.

failure_state.description: The six non-NONE names are verbatim from the issue #464 body. Recording one is what keeps a failed live turn distinguishable from a turn that was never spent.

acceptance_receipt.description: The compiled codex-live-acceptance-receipt-v2 this run produced. Null is only admissible below PASS: compile_codex_live_acceptance.py writes no file at all on failure.

executor_observation.description: What executed, observed on the machine that ran it. binary_verified_at_readback is the durable record of whether the digest was recomputable at readback time: an independent Shadow machine no longer holds the binary, so the recomputation fails open there unless this flag says it already happened here.

codex_binary_source.description: SDK_PINNED_RUNTIME is what the openai-codex SDK actually runs: codex_cli_bin.bundled_codex_path(), a sibling distribution of openai_codex in site-packages, not an executable inside the openai_codex package tree.

which_codex_before_run.description: `which codex` captured before the turn. Recorded so a PATH copy can be told apart from the executable the SDK pinned; it is never itself executor identity.
